_provenance.source_repo: https://github.com/trycua/cua (MIT; LICENSE sits beside this file)
_provenance.why: Cua's own golden trajectories are the only way to know Mewndo's agent cursor moves like Cua's. The full fixture is 462 KB and also covers tuned knob sets, custom MotionSpecs, effect frames, RNG and easing tables that Mewndo's MotionPlanner does not expose; this subset is the six built-in styles with default parameters at native and fitts timing over Cua's four canonical moves, and nothing else.
_provenance.shape: grid[i] = [t_seconds, x, y, heading_radians], 25 points evenly spaced over the move (tests/common/golden_cases.rs, GRID = 24).
